scope: host selector logic, reference-kernel userspace and private Android v2 format only

data.init_diff:
--- frozen/ramdisk-init
+++ owner-udc/ramdisk-init
@@ -36,11 +36,20 @@
         ;;
 esac
 
+# OWNER_UDC_SELECTOR_BEGIN
+select_owner_udc() {
+    # Fixed owner observation; no argument, environment override or fallback.
+    owner_udc=/sys/class/udc/a600000.dwc3
+    test -d "$owner_udc" &&
+    test -f "$owner_udc/state" && test -r "$owner_udc/state" &&
+    test -f "$owner_udc/maximum_speed" && test -r "$owner_udc/maximum_speed" || return 1
+    echo a600000.dwc3
+}
+# OWNER_UDC_SELECTOR_END
+
 mkdir -p /sys/kernel/config
 if mount -t configfs configfs /sys/kernel/config; then
-    set -- /sys/class/udc/*
-    if [ "$#" = 1 ] && [ -e "$1" ]; then
-        udc=${1##*/}
+    if udc=$(select_owner_udc); then
         gadget=/sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/tb371fc_entry
         if mkdir "$gadget"; then
             echo 0x1d6b >"$gadget/idVendor"
@@ -64,7 +73,7 @@
             fi
         fi
     else
-        echo "TB371FC_ENTRY_UDC_UNRESOLVED: require exactly one enumerated UDC"
+        echo "TB371FC_ENTRY_UDC_UNRESOLVED: require observed a600000.dwc3 with readable UDC metadata"
     fi
 fi

build_inputs.userspace_vm_scope: rescue userspace only on the frozen research2 reference kernel; NOT a downstream entry-kernel pass

limits: The selector tests execute the exact fixed-path production function under ARM BusyBox with mocked shell test predicates. They do not access or bind a real UDC.

The generic virt VM sets tb371fc.entry_smoke=1, which deliberately skips the gadget branch. Its pass proves the repacked rescue userland reaches PID 1 on the frozen research2 kernel, not USB selection or enumeration in a VM or on the tablet.

The Android observation identifies the configured a600000.dwc3 controller at capture time. Readable UDC metadata does not prove bindability, cable connectivity, peripheral role, or driver equivalence in the newly compiled downstream kernel.

The old compiled public 4.19.325 entry kernel and its prior generic-virt Qualcomm SCM failure are unchanged. No missing Lenovo board driver or historical handoff patch is supplied by this ramdisk change.

The private image preserves the owner recovery header fields, DTB and recovery DTBO as previously defined. Format verification does not authenticate the image or establish that its board contracts and load addresses are valid at runtime.

All original entry source and artifacts remain immutable. The private candidate uses the original kernel-oriented entry-r1 filename inside a new userspace-r2-owner-udc prefix; it does not overwrite the old candidate.

reproduction.prerequisites: Frozen first-stage kernel and userspace manifests/artifacts, owner recovery_a private input, frozen research2 artifacts, exact helper sources and USB capture hashes listed in this record. Run only inside the authorized isolated build container.
reproduction.notes: Use a fresh accepted -NN prefix for another attempt. The old helper names and private candidate basename refer to the unchanged entry-r1 kernel; the containing prefix and manifests identify the new ramdisk.
